args.command:
python - <<'EOF'
from outlines.types import hex_str, uuid4, ipv4, octal_str
from uuid import uuid4 as gen

tests = [
    (hex_str, "0x1a3F", True), (hex_str, "1a3F", True), (hex_str, "0XFF", True),
    (hex_str, "0x", False), (hex_str, "zz", False), (hex_str, "", False),
    (hex_str, "GHI", False), (hex_str, "0xZZZ", False),
    (uuid4, "123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000", True),
    (uuid4, "123e4567-e89b-42d3-8456-426614174000", True),
    (uuid4, str(gen()), True),
    (uuid4, "123e4567-e89b-52d3-a456-426614174000", False),  # version 5
    (uuid4, "123e4567-e89b-42d3-c456-426614174000", False),  # variant c not allowed
    (uuid4, "123e4567-e89b-42d3-7456-426614174000", False),
    (uuid4, "123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-42661417400", False),
    (ipv4, "192.168.1.1", True), (ipv4, "0.0.0.0", True),
    (ipv4, "255.255.255.255", True), (ipv4, "256.1.1.1", False),
    (ipv4, "1.2.3", False), (ipv4, "1.2.3.4.5", False),
    (ipv4, "10.00.1.1", False), (ipv4, "abc", False),
    (octal_str, "0o755", True), (octal_str, "0o644", True),
    (octal_str, "0o0", True), (octal_str, "755", False),
    (octal_str, "0o89", False), (octal_str, "8o755", False),
    (octal_str, "", False), (octal_str, " 0o755", False),
]
fails = 0
for t, s, exp in tests:
    got = t.matches(s)
    if got is not exp:
        fails += 1
        print("FAIL", t.name, repr(s), "expected", exp, "got", got)
print("done", fails, "failures")
EOF
